authorization: Root explicitly authorized task-owned package cache repair, exact Q3 attempt2, then the unchanged Q4/green/fix sequence with fail-stop gates. This review does not create new product or deployment authority.

repair_prerequisite: Exact repair schema/state/exit/script hash and E source head/tree.
Exact task target with no active native compiler process and verified old artifact archive.
Exact cargo clean -p codex-hepta-intelligence-eval command exit zero with stdout/stderr hashes.
Original diagnostic and failed Q3/outer evidence hashes preserved.
fresh_q3_prerequisite: The raw original test command must report Compiling eval from source-next.
The old unused enum import warning must be absent.
Every remaining eval dep-info file must have a post-clean timestamp and include product_qualification_use.rs; at least one file is required.
order: Q3 attempt2 original digest assertion at line 713 and exact restore
Q4 original Evidence assertion at line 474 and exact restore
original scoped fix last, no tests rerun after fix

independent_checks.prior_phase_lookup: The frozen runner searches successful same-source receipts and chooses the greatest successful attempt. The failed Q3 v1 receipt does not qualify; Q4 can consume successful Q3 v2 without rewriting history.
independent_checks.repair_scope: The task-exclusive flock and exact resolved target guard surround the package-only cleanup. Old fcbed files are hash-checked before and after copying. Clean source and Cargo.lock are checked before/after. No first source or test content writes.

limits: This is source/delta review, not a statement that cache repair or Q3 retry has completed.
Actual phase stderr, first panic, summary, restore receipts, and fresh dependency provenance still need readback.
No production source, assertion, feature, profile, timeout, retry policy, or release gate was relaxed.
No Cargo command was executed by the independent reviewer.
